page.layout: One printed page of text, single column. Running head at top, with page number at top left. Main text centred in the column, with a centred heading (EPIST. XXVI.) and a title passage in indented lines. Greeting in italic, then the opening paragraph with a large initial V. Catchword "ma" at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: spondeat, nullaque versio cum archety-po facilius ista comparari possit. Hæc habui, perillustris & mihi observantis-sime Domine, quæ doctissimis Litteris tuis rescriberem, me ut magis ac magis a-mes etiam atque etiam rogo.
main_text.head: EPIST. XXVI.

Responsio ad præcedentem Epistolam Ephemerides Persicæ ac Turcicæ, quas penes se asservabat Auctor Tabularum Astronomicarum, quibus nunc Persæ utuntur, & de his judicium. Diagramma Triacontaeteridis Arabicæ, quam ab Astronomo Persa habuerat.
main_text.p: Reverendo Patri atque Eruditissimo Domino meo, Patri Joanni Morino, Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero, Petrus à Valle Peregrinus, S. P. D.
Valde delectatus sum, Doctissime, ac mihi semper Reverende, mi Pater, iis omnibus, quæ ad me rescripsisti postre-

page.notes: The scan shows show-through and speckle at the edges, left out. The printed spacing "rescriberem,me" was normalised to "rescriberem, me". The printed "ha-uerat" with a stray mark was read as "habuerat". The last word "postrema" is split across the line end and the catchword "ma".
